narrative.overview: A maintainer should be able to open a project for thirty seconds and understand what agents have carried forward, without being asked to operate a coordination workflow.

rules.name: The Agent Loop Rule
rules.body: Skill, CLI, and MCP are the primary interfaces. The dashboard exposes their durable output.

rules.name: The Log Rule
rules.body: Open a project directly into one searchable stream. Do not split it into coordination panels.

rules.name: The Quiet Rule
rules.body: Only temporary menus and dialogs receive elevation. Records remain rows on one continuous surface.

dos: Keep what, why, who, and runtime together.
Make old context visibly historical without hiding it.
donts: Do not ask humans to submit proposed work.
Do not present conflict detection as a dashboard workflow.
Do not use metrics, agent theatres, kanban boards, or nested cards.
